graph_subtitle: Find the exact sweet spot for your daily games to maintain a high win rate in your current ELO and check back whenever you rank up
js_default_text: Hover over a rank to see the pacing analysis.

js_texts.mestre: Master+: Absolute High Performance. Micro-mistakes here cost the entire game. Your peak is 2 games max; from the 3rd game onward, decision fatigue completely tanks your LP gains.
js_texts.diamante: Diamond: Consistency is King. You can stay sharp for about 3 to 4 games. Forcing long sessions triggers 'autopilot'—the ultimate bracket-stuck killer in High ELO.
js_texts.esmeralda: Plat & Emerald: The Mental Gaps. Your mechanics will hold until game 4, but your mental resilience drops fast. Save your ELO: walk away if you drop two in a row.
js_texts.ouro: Gold: Mid-Tier Balance. You can grind a decent volume (up to 5-6 games) because throws aren't instantly punished, but your macro focus fades hard by the end of the session.
js_texts.prata: Silver: Practice Volume. Fatigue rarely tanks your win rate here since the bracket demands less raw macro focus. Spamming games to fix your core fundamentals is the play.
js_texts.ferro: Iron/Bronze: Brute Force. Fatigue isn't the bottleneck here. Grinding out match experience and limit-testing beats mental drain every time. Feel free to power-grind long sessions.
